gloss: to economize, to cut back, to reduce

definitions.explanation: To reduce expenses or consumption; to live frugally by cutting costs.
To make something shorter or smaller by cutting.

examples.japanese: {生活費|せいかつひ}を{切|き}り{詰|つ}めて{貯金|ちょきん}している。
examples.english: I'm saving money by cutting back on living expenses.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{切|き}り{詰|つ}める{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to cut the budget.

examples.japanese: {食費|しょくひ}を{切|き}り{詰|つ}めた{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: I'm living a life with reduced food expenses.

examples.japanese: {原稿|げんこう}を{切|き}り{詰|つ}めて{規定|きてい}の{字数|じすう}に{収|おさ}めた。
examples.english: I trimmed down the manuscript to fit within the word limit.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Compound verb: {切|き}る + {詰|つ}める.

PATTERN: Xを{切|き}り{詰|つ}める (cut back on X / trim X)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{生活|せいかつ}を{切|き}り{詰|つ}める (economize on lifestyle)
・{予算|よさん}を{切|き}り{詰|つ}める (cut the budget)
・{費用|ひよう}を{切|き}り{詰|つ}める (reduce costs)
・{切|き}り{詰|つ}めた{生活|せいかつ} (frugal lifestyle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{節約|せつやく}する: To economize (neutral, general)
・{切|き}り{詰|つ}める: To cut back (implies sacrifice, doing without)
・けちる: To skimp (casual, slightly negative)
